steps.title: Prepare RNase-Free Environment and Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Decontaminate the workspace and prepare the cell lysis buffer to prevent mRNA degradation.

substeps.instruction: Wipe the outer surfaces of centrifuge tubes, tube racks, pipettes, centrifuges, and operating tables with RNaseZap™ Wipes.
Use RNase-free pipette tips with filters; wear a mask and periodically wipe gloves and items with wet wipes.
Prepare RLT+ buffer by adding 10 μL of β-mercaptoethanol per 1 mL of RLT buffer in an RNase-free centrifuge tube; mix well and label with name and date (stable at room temperature for one month).

steps.title: Cell Lysis and mRNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract mRNA from cell clones using an RNeasy MinElute spin column.

substeps.instruction: Gently pipette cell clones into a clean RNase-free 1.5 mL centrifuge tube and centrifuge at 500 g for 4 min; discard supernatant.

Add 75 μL of RLT+ buffer if cell count is ≤ 1*10^5. If cell count is < 500, add an additional 5 μL of carrier RNA solution (prepared by mixing 5 μL 310 ng/μL stock with 34 μL RLT buffer, then taking 6 μL of that mix and adding 54 μL RLT buffer to create a 4 ng/μL working solution).
Vortex at maximum speed for > 15 sec to ensure complete lysis.
Add one volume of 70% ethanol (prepared from absolute ethanol and RNase-free water), pipette, and mix well.
Transfer to an RNeasy MinElute spin column, centrifuge at >8000g for 30 sec, and discard flow-through.
Add 350 μL RW1 buffer, centrifuge at >8000g for 30 sec, and discard flow-through.
Mix 10 μL DNase I stock with 70 μL RDD buffer, add to the column, and incubate at room temperature (20-30°C) for 15-20 min.
Add 350 μL RW1 buffer, centrifuge at >8000g for 30 sec, and discard flow-through.
Add 500 μL RPE buffer, centrifuge at >8000g for 30 sec, and discard flow-through.
Add 500 μL 80% ethanol (prepared from absolute ethanol and RNase-free water), centrifuge at >8000g for 2 min, and discard flow-through and collection tube.
Place column in a new 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge at highest speed for 5 min to evaporate alcohol.
Transfer column to a new 1.5 mL collection tube, add 14 μL of 37°C preheated RNase-free water, and centrifuge at 15,000 rpm for 1 min to elute mRNA.
Measure mRNA concentration using Nanodrop; avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.

steps.title: cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Reverse transcribe the extracted mRNA into cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare pre-mix sample: Mix 5.05 μL Total RNA, 0.5 μL rab-IgL-V-p1, and 0.5 μL rab-IgH-V-p1; incubate 3 min at 72°C and 2 min at 42°C.

Generate cDNA: Mix 6.05 μL pre-mix sample, 2 μL 5x first strand buffer, 0.2 μL DTT (100mM), 0.5 μL dNTP (20mM), 0.25 μL RNase inhibitor (40U/μL), and 1 μL SMART reverse transcriptase; incubate 90 min at 42°C and 10 min at 72°C.
Add 50 μL Tricine-EDTA buffer I to the cDNA sample (can be stored at -20°C for up to 3 months).

steps.title: VH and VL Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the variable heavy (VH) and light (VL) regions via PCR.

substeps.instruction: Set up PCR reaction: 5.1 μL H2O, 2 μL 5x Phusion HF Buffer, 1 μL dNTP (2mM), 0.5 μL Up-pcDNA3.4-rab-IgL or Up-pcDNA3.4-rab-IgH, 0.5 μL rab-IgL-V-Pex or rab-IgH-V-Pex, 0.3 μL DMSO, 0.1 μL Phusion DNA polymerase, and 0.5 μL cDNA.
Run PCR thermal cycling: 30 sec at 98°C, then 35 cycles of (10 sec at 98°C, 30 sec at 65°C, 20 sec at 72°C), ending with 5 min at 72°C.
Analyze 10 μL PCR products on a 1% agarose gel (using 5%-10% Loading buffer). If successful, scale up to a 50 μL system.
Purify PCR products with a PCR purification kit and quantify via Nanodrop.

steps.title: Ligation and Transformation
steps.instruction: Ligate the PCR products into vectors and transform into competent cells.

substeps.instruction: Perform Gibson Assembly: Mix 2.5 μL Gibson Assembly® Master Mix, 0.5 μL linearized modified pcDNA3.4 (carrying CH or CL), 50 ng rab-VH/VL PCR product, and H2O to a final volume of 5 μL; incubate 15 min at 50°C.
Transform DH5α cells: Add 5 μL ligation product to 30-50 μL DH5α competent cells; ice-bath 30 min, heat shock at 42°C for 1.5 min, ice-bath 2 min.
Recover cells: Add 300-500 μL antibiotic-free LB medium and shake at 150 rpm for 45-60 min at 37°C.
Plate and incubate: Spin down cells, discard most supernatant, and spread pellet on AmpR plates (50 μg/mL Amp); incubate overnight at 37°C.

steps.title: Clone Screening and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Identify positive clones through colony PCR and sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Pick clones into 200 μL LB medium (50 μg/mL Amp) and shake at 37°C for 4 hours.
Perform screening PCR: Mix 5 μL Taq 2x Master Mix, 3 μL H2O, 0.5 μL rab-IgLV or rab-IgHV, 0.5 μL rab-IgL-V-Pex or rab-IgH-V-Pex, and 1 μL bacteria suspension.
Run PCR: 5 min at 98°C, 25 cycles of (20 sec at 94°C, 20 sec at 60°C, 40 sec at 68°C), and 5 min at 68°C.
Analyze products via DNA electrophoresis and subject positive clones to Sanger sequencing.

steps.title: Bioinformatic Selection of Chains
steps.instruction: Filter H and L chain sequences based on CDR3 criteria.

substeps.instruction: Translate DNA sequences to protein and identify CDR3 regions using bioinformatic tools (e.g., IMGT).
Align protein sequences using MUSCLE (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/Tools/msa/muscle/) and generate a phylogenetic tree.

Select H and L chains based on these rules: CDR3 length 8-20 residues; no more than 3 consecutive identical residues; at least one aromatic residue; no more than three (total or combination) of P, C, K, or Q.

steps.title: Small-Scale Expression Screening
steps.instruction: Transfect Expi293 cells in a 24-well plate to screen H/L pairs.

substeps.instruction: Prepare plasmids: Inoculate selected clones in 2 mL LB medium overnight, extract plasmids, and quantify via Nanodrop.
Prepare DNA mix: Add 25 μL Opti-MEM to each well of a 24-well plate, add 0.167 μg H plasmid and 0.333 μg L chain plasmid; mix gently.
Prepare transfection reagent: Mix 1.325 μL ExpiFectamine with 25 μL Opti-MEM in a 1.5 mL tube; incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Combine: Add 26 μL of the reagent mixture to each well; incubate at room temperature for 20-30 min.
Add cells: Add 0.425 mL Expi293 cells (3.3*10^6 cells/mL) per well and place on an orbital shaker at 125 rpm in an incubator.
Harvest: After 4-5 days, centrifuge at 8000 rpm for 10 min and collect supernatant for Bio-plex screening.

steps.title: Large-Scale Antibody Expression
steps.instruction: Express the high-signal H/L pair in a 30 mL system.

substeps.instruction: Prepare transfection solution: In one 15 mL tube, mix 1.5 mL OptiMEM and 80 μL ExpiFectamine. In another, mix 1.5 mL OptiMEM, 10 μg IgH plasmid, and 20 μg IgL plasmid. After 5 min, combine both tubes and incubate at room temperature for 20-30 min.
Prepare cells: Dilute cells to 3*10^6 cells/mL. Add 25.5 mL cell suspension to a 125 mL flask.
Transfect: Gently add the transfection solution to the cells and incubate at 37°C on an orbital shaker at 125 rpm overnight.
Enhance expression: 16 hours post-transfection, add 1.5 mL Enhancer 2 and 150 μL Enhancer 1 per flask; continue shaking at 125 rpm at 37°C.
Harvest: After 5 days, centrifuge culture medium at 8000 rpm for 10 min and store supernatant at 4°C.

steps.title: Antibody Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the antibody using a gravity column and verify concentration.

substeps.instruction: Prepare column: Remove seals from a 1 mL gravity column, pour off ethanol, wash with 20 mL water, and equilibrate with 10 mL binding buffer.
Load sample: Filter culture medium through a 0.45 μM filter and load onto the column; discard flow-through, then gradually add 10 mL binding buffer.
Elute: Prepare eight 1.5 mL tubes with 30 μL neutralizing buffer each. Elute with 350 μL elution buffer per tube, mixing the eluent with the neutralizing buffer.

Quantify: Use Coomassie chromogenic solution (8 drops of 30 μL on parafilm) and mix with 3 μL from each tube. Collect 2-4 tubes with high concentration (blue color), centrifuge at 12000 rpm for 1 min, and transfer supernatant.
Final Step: Dialyze samples in 1000 mL PBS at 4°C overnight and determine final concentration using Nanodrop.
